description: EXPR-MUTATION, deciding variant: error precedence of two invalid fields when declaration order and assignment order are swapped independently. MA declares A then B and MB declares B then A (each field has rule > 0 and its own ValidationText); on a newly opened recordset each table gets A = -1 and B = -1 assigned in both orders and Update; Errors after each put and each Update. Follow-up probe (status F) for EXPR-MUTATION, EXPR-STAGE; runs on a writable fresh copy of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
